spec.data_source: Read-only native credential metadata and exact credential-ID-filtered Cloud Monitoring request-count time series, daily sums, 365-day observation and 30-minute reporting lag. No credential secret value is requested.
spec.predicate: A matching successful request interval lies within the 90-day review period, or the credential was created within that period. Complete selected metric views contain an older successful request interval and no newer successful interval within 90 days; empty series alone cannot fail and this is a recorded-activity review signal.
spec.title: API key has recent recorded successful requests
spec.description: Reviews the latest recorded successful Service Runtime API requests identified by the current API key UID in its verified owner project. Current credential identity, active/deleted state, creation time, project bindings, exact native metric query, daily aggregation and observation interval must match. An old recorded successful interval with complete selected views fails as a cleanup-review candidate; it does not establish universal credential inactivity. Empty metrics, failed requests alone and incomplete observations remain unresolved. Recent positive use can survive another selected view failure.
spec.remediation_hint: Review credential ownership, workloads and other activity sources before removing an old recorded-activity candidate.

requirements.reason: Bounded access-credential lifecycle review signal: exact credential-ID metrics identify a current key with old recorded successful requests. This does not establish universal inactivity, organizational need, principal-wide access or actual deactivation; standard API keys may serve billing/quota association rather than principal authentication.
